svg.title: 03 | Smaller candles were associated with worse original outcomes
svg.desc: STAT001 · M15 · 2020–2023 spent Discovery · post-selection exploratory · 28,097 placed / 21,917 fills Quartiles rank engulf range / causal ATR among all placed orders within symbol-year; outcomes use fills. The primary estimate weights 12 strata equally. Post-selection exploratory interval, not selection-adjusted: 20,000 stratified signal-month block-bootstrap replicates. Symbol intervals unavailable. Observational, price-R evidence; XAU excluded for unresolved history identity. Anti-EBP PARKED; stop intervention and reversal economics unrun. Source B23.
